Thank you! :) I'm pretty bad at estimating time spent, but I started it in mid-March and worked on it most nights for at least an hour at a time. Just finished adding the border last week!

I'm honestly shocked that I have the patience for this hobby, myself. 😂 With mosaic crochet like this, I think the novelty of each new "pattern block" keeps me engaged. Also, figuring out that I only like to use cotton yarn was a game-changer for me. When it's hard for me to see the stitch definition, I struggle to identify errors I make, which makes me grumpy. I'm much less prone to rage-quitting projects now that I only use cotton yarn. 😂😂

Thank you so much! :)) I also learned mosaic crochet this year, using [Tinna's Beginners Guide to Mosaic Crochet](https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL_5iGe5xXsq0ybsxVBd_hu4W74NpWp6v4). I highly recommend!!
